headlines.text: It was 2023 when Andrade El Idolo vs. Bryan Danielson met in a Continental Classic League Match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 8.43 ? a real highlight of the night. Just 24 hours after his grueling war with Garcia, a battered Danielson dug deep to outlast a fresh Andrade and keep his Continental Classic win streak alive.

Rewind to 2022, when a new chapter began as Hikaru Shida vs. The Bunny fought for the brand-new Regina Di WAVE Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.20. Shida successfully defended her Regina di WAVE Championship against a returning Bunny, who'd spent six months rehabbing a neck injury before making her comeback.
Back on this day in 2020, MJF vs. Orange Cassidy met in a match with the Dynamite Diamond Ring on the line, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 6.76.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Trent Seven wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event against Orange Cassidy, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.46.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Eddie Kingston vs. Claudio Castagnoli met in a Continental Classic League Match, kicking off the show on Collision, rated 7.93 ? a match that delivered.
Looking back to 2022, when Jon Moxley vs. Konosuke Takeshita delivered a genuine showstealer on Rampage, rated 8.67.
